# Vantidge

> Vantidge (getvantidge.com) is a strategic finance firm in New York for seed and Series A startups that don't have a CFO yet. It builds the operating model on a company's real books, keeps it current every month, and runs financial due diligence when a raise or a sale shows up. Founded by Sophie Finke. Legal entity: Phinke LLC.

Vantidge is not Vantidge.ai, Vantage, or VantageScore.

## What Vantidge does

- Operating model tied to the company's actual books, first version within a week, with live formulas and a full Excel download
- Ledger, bank, billing and payroll connected and refreshed every night (QuickBooks Online, Mercury, Stripe, Bill.com, HubSpot and others), with mismatches flagged
- Dashboards shared by the founders and the board
- Month-end rolled into the model and a draft board deck
- Raise math: how much to raise and what it does to founder ownership
- Diligence war room for a fundraise or a company sale: data room, request tracker, written answers and Vantidge on the diligence calls
- Pricing: one monthly price set by scope, in writing after a 30-minute call

## Who it is for

Startups that need finance but have no finance team. In September 2026 Vantidge read the org charts of 45 New York startups and four had a CFO. Three of those were past Series B.

## Proof

Playground sold to Procare, a Roper Technologies company, in September 2026 with no banker and no finance team. The buyer had three consulting firms. Vantidge's founder ran the finance side: 439 diligence requests, 714 files, 27 diligence calls.
